tools.name: search_offers
tools.description: Search the RottenAds offer catalog. Every filter is optional; results are ranked with offers converting now first. Payout is what RottenAds pays the publisher per conversion (or the RevShare %).

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: Full details of one offer by its id (from search_offers).

tools.name: list_verticals
tools.description: Verticals in the catalog with the number of offers in each, and the traffic types offers accept.

tools.name: get_network_info
tools.description: How RottenAds works: payments, tracking, compliance rules, contact.

tools.name: apply_as_publisher
tools.description: Send a publisher (affiliate) application to RottenAds. Use the applicant's real details and only with their consent. A person reviews it; if approved, the dashboard login is emailed to the applicant. Returns a reference.

tools.name: apply_as_advertiser
tools.description: Send an advertiser application: an offer you want publishers to promote on a CPL/CPA/CPS/RevShare basis. Use the applicant's real details and only with their consent. Our team answers by email. Returns a reference.
